sn2.22:1.1: Standing to one side, Khema the deva’s son recited these verses in the Blessed One’s presence.
sn2.22:3.1:
It’s not good,
the doing of the deed
sn2.22:3.2:
that, once it’s done,
you regret,
sn2.22:3.3:
whose result you reap crying,
your face in tears.
sn2.22:4.1:
It’s good,
the doing of the deed
sn2.22:4.2:
that, once it’s done,
you don’t regret,
sn2.22:4.4:
whose result you reap gratified,
happy at heart.
sn2.22:5.1: You should do prudently, right away,
sn2.22:5.2: what you know is for your own benefit.
sn2.22:5.4:
you shouldn’t strive
for the sake of the cart driver’s thinking.
sn2.22:6.1: Just as a cart driver who—
sn2.22:6.2:
having left
the smoothed, even highway,
sn2.22:6.3: and climbed onto an uneven path—
sn2.22:7.1:
in the same way,
a fool—having departed from Dhamma
sn2.22:7.3: having fallen into the mouth of death—
